text:
maria-ops: CI canary publish failing on infra/runner-images after a tiny .dockerignore tweak. buildx --push errors out during layer upload with a 400 and 'empty blob' in the registry response. anyone seen this recently?

jonathan-ci: not 403, so creds likely fine. empty blob usually means the registry finalized an upload with zero bytes for that chunk/digest. which layer index does it show? link the job?

maria-ops: job: https://ci.example.com/teams/infra/builds/1256
error snippet: ```time="..." level=error msg="upload failed: unexpected status: 400 Bad Request: empty blob uploaded for digest sha256:4b..."```
layer 3/7 when pushing. changed .dockerignore to exclude `.cache` and a symlink in repo got removed. Dockerfile has `COPY --chown=1000:1000 . /app` earlier.

sam-build: are you using buildkit cache import/export? or local cache from previous parallel runs? Also buildx or docker build?

maria-ops: buildx (kaniko previously). We use buildkit with cache-from enabled in CI to speed up.

jonathan-ci: cache interactions + chown/COPY symlink changes are a classic combo for an empty blob. Buildkit might reuse a cache entry that points to a removed file, resulting in an upload zero-length blob. Quick repro: add --no-cache and see if push succeeds.

sam-build: also try BUILDKIT_PROGRESS=plain to get clearer logs. If --no-cache fixes it, we can bisect cache layer key generation.

maria-ops: kicking rerun with --no-cache now. cc @devops-bot to annotate run.

devops-bot: build #1256 (rerun) started by @maria-ops — queued on linux-runner-12

maria-ops: rerun completed, push succeeded with --no-cache. so yeah flaky cache.

sam-build: sounds like cached layer was stale/empty. For a short-term fix add --no-cache to this pipeline or clear buildx cache between commits that touch filesystem layout. For long-term, we should ensure cache keys include inode/mtime of copied files or avoid copying symlinks blindly.

jonathan-ci: opening a follow-up: GH issue in infra/ci: "buildx cache reuse can produce empty-blob pushes after .dockerignore changes". assign to infra-build team, include logs and the working --no-cache command.

maria-ops: thanks all. I'll update the PR to avoid the symlink removal in the same commit as the .dockerignore change and add a CI job to run a no-cache publish on canary branches for a few hours after such changes. :+1:

sam-build: we should also add a short healthcheck in the push step: if registry returns empty-blob 400, automatically retry with --no-cache once and attach logs. cuts down on manual reruns.

maria-ops: agreed. filing that as a separate improvement ticket. closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
